items.quote: And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, neither would he let the children of Israel go; as the LORD had spoken by Moses.
items.claim: According to the narrative in Exodus 9:35, Pharaoh's heart was hardened and he refused to let the Israelites go, which the text presents as fulfilling what the LORD had foretold through Moses.
items.action: refused to let the children of Israel go
items.mechanism: hardening of Pharaoh's heart, framed as foretold by the LORD through Moses
